subject: VP Offsite Summit — connectivity & carrier provisioning plan
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Harper Venue Sales <harper.sales@harpervenues.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme Travel <events@acmetravel.com>
Date: Sun, 02 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: VP Offsite Summit — initial connectivity & carrier asks

Team / Harper,

We are locking in the VP offsite (June 21–23) and need to finalize connectivity/carrier provisioning for the main plenary and two breakout rooms. High-level asks below — attached is the requirements doc and preferred room overview.

Primary requirements:
- Primary uplink: 1Gbps dedicated fiber to the plenary with L3 routing (must support 10 concurrent HD streams + 2 company VPN tunnels).
- Backup: secondary ISP across a different POP (ideally active/standby with automatic failover).
- SIP and PSTN termination options for external attendees (we need PSTN numbers for APAC dialing).
- STUN/TURN relay(s) and firewall pinholes documented for our EngOps team.
- Dedicated VLAN(s) for Redwood devices + ability to tag traffic for QoS.

AV asks (short):
- Support for dual-SDI feeds from the main stage, plus HDMI patching in two breakout rooms.
- In-room codecs but ability to fallback to cloud SIP bridge if onsite bridge latency spikes.

Timing: we need a detailed carrier/ops plan by EOD Wednesday (May 5) so procurement can issue orders and we can schedule a site walk.

Attachments: vp_summit_requirements.docx, preferred_rooms_overview.pdf

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Programs, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0182

From: Harper Venue Sales <harper.sales@harpervenues.com>

Cc: Acme Travel <events@acmetravel.com>
Date: Mon, 03 May 2027 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: VP Offsite Summit — initial connectivity & carrier asks

Hi Vanessa / team,

Thanks for the detailed brief — we can support the topology you described. Quick summary and open items below: 

What we can provision:
- Primary: 1Gbps lit fiber (route A) terminated in our MMR; private VLAN available with BGP peering to your IPs.
- Backup: 500Mbps secondary fiber via carrier B (route B) with automated failover (BGP + health probe).
- PSTN: Local DID pools for US/UK/APAC, with optional toll-free numbers.
- STUN/TURN: Managed relay available; we will provide FQDN + IP ranges for firewall config.

Open items / clarifications we need from Redwood:
1) Public ASN or specific BGP preferences for peering?
2) Do you want the backup link active/passive or active/active? Active/active will require traffic steering and additional config.
3) Will Redwood provide MACs for edge switches or should we reserve DHCP + static-mapping?

Estimate to provision primary + backup + PSTN +/- managed STUN: $8,500 (one-time install) + $1,200/mo in venue service. We can give exact numbers once the BGP/peering model is confirmed.

We can schedule a site walk next week (May 10–12) — Tom from our AV partner (cc'd on the next message) will confirm room-level AV inventory.

Regards,
Claire Harper
Venue Sales, Harper Venues
harper.sales@harpervenues.com
+1 212-555-0421

From: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@audioworks.com>

Cc: Harper Venue Sales <harper.sales@harpervenues.com>
Date: Mon, 03 May 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: AV / bridge notes for VP Offsite — preliminary room matrix attached

Hi all,

Attaching the AV_Room_Matrix.xlsx with our preliminary inventory and recommended bridge topology. High-level recommendations:

- Main plenary:
  - 2 x 4K cameras (NDI + SDI outputs), dual 60" confidence monitors, Blackmagic ATEM switcher, and redundant encoders.
  - Onsite MCU (H.323/SIP) for low-latency internal calls; fallback to vendor cloud SIP bridge (we usually push to cloud when packet-loss > 2%).
  - Local NTP + PTP sync for AV devices to prevent drift across streams.

- Breakouts A/B:
  - HDMI capture + one PTZ camera each, wired returns, and an HDMI over IP option if we need to route local feeds to the plenary.

Network / carrier considerations:
- We strongly advise a dedicated /30 for the primary encoders and a separate /30 for the backup encoders to simplify ACLs.
- STUN/TURN uptime is critical — we recommend a managed TURN cluster with at least 3 anycast endpoints (we can provision).
- When using cloud bridge fallback, enable SRTP and ensure the venue's SBC supports TLS/SRTP passthrough.

Site walk scope: patch locations, rack space in MMR, fiber handoff, and onsite carrier demarc. Recommend a two-hour walk for plenary + both breakouts.

Thanks,
Tom Nguyen
Lead Systems Engineer — AudioWorks
tom.nguyen@audioworks.com
+1 646-555-1199

Attachment: av_room_matrix.xlsx

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 04 May 2027 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: VP Offsite Summit — initial connectivity & carrier asks

Vanessa / all,

Thanks — Claire and Tom, this looks good. Quick internal decisions so we can move forward: 
- BGP peering: we will provide a public ASN and request a /29 NAT'd range for our outbound services.
- Backup link: active/standby is fine for cost reasons, but we want automated failover with health checks and documented RTO < 2 minutes.
- Reserve DHCP with static mappings for the vendor gear; we will provide MACs as devices are inventoried.

Action items: 
- Vanessa: confirm site walk window (I can join May 11 morning).
- Laura: please open a procurement ticket so Claire can issue the order (include HS-8932).
- Markus: loop in EngOps for firewall changes and put the STUN/TURN FQDNs on the allowlist.

Ben

- Onsite parking and dock access: Harper will provide a loading bay pass for vendor trucks; shipping labels should use "Redwood / VP Summit — Attn: Logistics".
- Test schedule: recommend a dry run on June 20 (half-day) to validate encoders, STUN/TURN, and SIP termination.

2) Laura: procurement ticket + HS-8932 by EOD May 5.
3) Claire/Harper: final install quote and carrier order form by EOD May 5.

If we get those items in place this week we should be clear to go into procurement and lock travel.

Thanks everyone — see you on the 11th.
